newsitem.title: ANGOLA: Port conditions update - Angola - Lloyds Shipping.
newsitem.headline: Port conditions update - Angola - Lloyds Shipping.

text.p: Port conditions from Lloyds Shipping Intelligence Service --

ANGOLA, Feb 27 - Luanda - Due to the change in approvals by customs for clearance of cargo, continuing congestion is being faced in the port area and discharge of vessels was being slowed or delayed. There was no reported delay to berthing of product tankers at the refinery buoy. Crude terminals reported operating normally.
